Creates an ACL.

Authorizations:
api_key
Request Body schema: application/json
required

The ACL to create

required
Array of objects (aci) non-empty

A list of ACIs for this ACL

deprecated
required
boolean non-empty

A boolean flag that specifies whether this ACL is deprecated

description
required
string non-empty

A description for this ACL

forData
required
boolean non-empty

A boolean flag that specifies whether this ACL is intended for data

uuid
required
string <uuid> = 36 characters

The UUID of the ACL

CreateActuator

Creates an actuator

Authorizations:
api_key
Request Body schema: application/json
required

The actuator to create.

api_poll_rate
required
integer <int64> (Duration)

A Duration represents the elapsed time between two instants as an int64 nanosecond count. The representation limits the largest representable duration to approximately 290 years.

required
object (integrationConfigRequest)

IntegrationConfigRequest is a request to create the config for an actuator or connector

required
object (integrationConfigSchema)

IntegrationConfigSchema is the schema for the config of an actuator or connector

description
string

The description of the actuator

heartbeat_rate
integer <int64> (Duration)

A Duration represents the elapsed time between two instants as an int64 nanosecond count. The representation limits the largest representable duration to approximately 290 years.

log_level
required
string (LogLevel)

LogLevel represents a logging level

name
required
string

The name of the actuator

principal_uuid
required
string <uuid> = 36 characters

The UUID of the actuator's user account

supported_connector_types
required
Array of strings <uuid> [ items <uuid > ]

The UUIDs of the connector types supported by this actuator

Responses

http://localhost/cydarm-api/actuator
https://localhost/cydarm-api/actuator

auth

doAuthWithPassword

Creates a session by using username and password in the request body

Username and Password in the json payload must be base64 encoded.

For example: If the username was john_smith and the password was P@s5word!, then the payload would need to look the like following:

{"username":"am9obl9zbWl0aA==","password":"UEBzNXdvcmQh"}
Authorizations:
api_key
Request Body schema: application/json
required

The base64 encoded user's credentials

password
required
string

Base64 encoded Password

username
required
string

Base64 encoded Username

Responses

http://localhost/cydarm-api/auth/password

case-filter

Cases

Get filtered list of cases

Returns a paginated, filtered list of cases conforming to JSON:API specification. Supports sparse fieldsets via fields[case] parameter and related resource inclusion via include parameter.

Authorizations:
api_key
query Parameters
page[number]
required
integer

The results page to return

page[size]
required
integer

The size of each page to return

include
Array of strings

Which additional objects to include

fields[case]
string

Sparse fieldsets - comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If specified, only the listed fields (attributes and relationships) will be returned. If not specified, all fields are returned. Example: fields[case]=locator,description,severity

filter[create_start]
string <date-time>

Filter cases created on or after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

filter[create_end]
string <date-time>

Filter cases created on or before this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

filter[mod_start]
string <date-time>

Filter cases modified on or after this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

filter[mod_end]
string <date-time>

Filter cases modified on or before this timestamp (ISO 8601 format)

filter[status]
string

Filter cases by workflow status (comma-delimited list of status names)

filter[org]
string

Filter cases by organisation (comma-delimited list of organisation names)

filter[assignee]
string

Filter cases by assignee (comma-delimited list of assignee names)

filter[severity]
string

Filter cases by severity (comma-delimited list of severity names)

filter[text]
string

Full-text search across case locator, description, and metadata values

filter[parent_uuid]
string

Filter cases by parent case UUIDs (comma-delimited list of UUIDs)

filter[member_uuid]
string <uuid>

Filter cases by member case UUID

filter[inc_tag]
string

Filter cases that have any of these tags (comma-delimited list of tag names)

filter[exc_tag]
string

Filter cases that do not have any of these tags (comma-delimited list of tag names)

filter[untagged]
boolean

Filter for cases that have no tags (cannot be used with filter[inc_tag])

sort
string
Default: "created"

Field to sort results by (description, created, modified, org, assignee, status, severity, severity_name, min_sla_name, min_sla_seconds, closed, actions, completed_actions)

sort_dir
string
Default: "desc"
Enum: "asc" "desc"

Sort direction (asc or desc)

Responses

{protocol}://{hostname}.{domain}{port}/{basePath}/{apiVersion}/v0.9/case

case-report

Case reports

Generate a case report

Generates an incident report for the specified case.

Supported formats:

  • markdown (default): Returns the report as markdown text in a JSON:API response, suitable for client-side rendering to HTML and printing as PDF.
  • docx: Returns the report as a binary DOCX file download, converted via the Pandoc service.
Authorizations:
api_key
path Parameters
uuid
required
string <UuidPtr>

The resource UUID

query Parameters
format
string
Default: "markdown"
Enum: "markdown" "docx"

Output format for the report. "markdown" returns the report as markdown text in a JSON:API response. "docx" returns the report as a binary DOCX file download.

startTime
string <date-time>

Start time for the report window as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z")

endTime
string <date-time>

End time for the report window as an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z")

timezone
string
Default: "UTC"

Timezone for timestamps in the report (e.g., "Australia/Sydney")

aclGroups
Array of strings

ACL groups to filter data visibility

significances
Array of strings

Significance levels to include in the report

Responses

{protocol}://{hostname}.{domain}{port}/{basePath}/{apiVersion}/v0.9/case-report/{uuid}

CreateSla

Creates an SLAs

Authorizations:
api_key
Request Body schema: application/json
required

The SLA to create.

aclUuid
required
string <uuid> = 36 characters

The UUID of the ACL for the SLA

applicability
required
string

The applicability, eg. 24x7x365 or business hours only)

completedTime
string

What time this SLA was completed for a case

deprecated
boolean

Whether this SLA is deprecated

endState
required
string

The state at which the SLA is ended

hoursApplicableEnd
required
string

The time at which the SLA is no longer enabled

hoursApplicableStart
required
string

The time from which the SLA is enabled

hoursApplicableTz
required
string

The timezone from which the SLA is enabled

name
string

The Name of this SLA (determined automatically if not provided)

orgUuid
required
string = 36 characters

The organisation for whom this SLA is in force

pauseStateName
string

A state for which the SLA is paused

pausedSince
string

When this SLA was paused for a case

severityPrecedence
required
integer <int64>

The precedence of the severity for the SLA

startState
required
string

The state from which the SLA is enabled

startTime
string

What time this SLA was added to a case

timeLimit
required
string

The time limit associated with this SLA

timeRemaining
string

How much time is left in this SLA for a case

uuid
string = 36 characters

The UUID of the SLA

version
string

The version of this SLA

warningState
string

The most severe warning state on this case, if any

warningTime
string

Distance from SLA breach (negative being after breach)

Responses

http://localhost/cydarm-api/sla
https://localhost/cydarm-api/sla

Authorizations:
api_key
path Parameters
slaUuid
required
string

The UUID of the SLA to update.

Request Body schema: application/json
required

The SLA to update.

aclUuid
required
string <uuid> = 36 characters

The UUID of the ACL for the SLA

applicability
required
string

The applicability, eg. 24x7x365 or business hours only)

completedTime
string

What time this SLA was completed for a case

deprecated
boolean

Whether this SLA is deprecated

endState
required
string

The state at which the SLA is ended

hoursApplicableEnd
required
string

The time at which the SLA is no longer enabled

hoursApplicableStart
required
string

The time from which the SLA is enabled

hoursApplicableTz
required
string

The timezone from which the SLA is enabled

name
string

The Name of this SLA (determined automatically if not provided)

orgUuid
required
string = 36 characters

The organisation for whom this SLA is in force

pauseStateName
string

A state for which the SLA is paused

pausedSince
string

When this SLA was paused for a case

severityPrecedence
required
integer <int64>

The precedence of the severity for the SLA

startState
required
string

The state from which the SLA is enabled

startTime
string

What time this SLA was added to a case

timeLimit
required
string

The time limit associated with this SLA

timeRemaining
string

How much time is left in this SLA for a case

uuid
string = 36 characters

The UUID of the SLA

version
string

The version of this SLA

warningState
string

The most severe warning state on this case, if any

warningTime
string

Distance from SLA breach (negative being after breach)

Responses

http://localhost/cydarm-api/sla/{slaUuid}

visualization

Chart visualizations

Gets a specific data set visualization for a chart -- specifically in Vega format

Returns Vega-Lite formatted data to be visually displayed

Authorizations:
api_key
query Parameters
chartType
required
string
Enum: "bar" "pie" "heatmap" "line" "table"

The visual shape of the chart

dataType
required
string
Enum: "case-data" "sla-data"

The data source for the visualization

filter[create_start]
string

Earliest creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format

filter[create_end]
string

Latest creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format

filter[state]
string

Comma-delimited list of state names to filter by

filter[org]
string

Comma-delimited list of org names or UUIDs to filter by

filter[assignee]
string

Comma-delimited list of assignee names to filter by

filter[severity]
string

Comma-delimited list of severity names to filter by

filter[inc_tag]
string

Comma-delimited list of tags to include

filter[exc_tag]
string

Comma-delimited list of tags to exclude

page[size]
integer

Number of items per page. Used by table (default 20) and bar with group_by_x=tag (default 10).

page[number]
integer

Zero-indexed page number. Used by table (default 0). Ignored by other chart types.

transform[interval]
string^[1-9][0-9]?[hdwMQy]$

Time interval for time-series charts (defaults vary by chart type)

transform[group_by_x]
string

Primary grouping axis. Allowed values depend on the chart type.

transform[group_by_y]
string

Secondary grouping axis. Allowed values depend on the chart type.

transform[aggregate]
string

Aggregation function. Allowed values depend on the data type.

transform[sort]
string

Sort field name for result ordering

transform[sort_dir]
string
Enum: "asc" "desc"

Sort direction for result ordering

transform[timezone]
string
Default: "UTC"

IANA timezone name (e.g. "Australia/Sydney", "America/New_York"). Controls time-bucketing alignment and time-derived dimensions (day_of_week, hour_of_day). Defaults to UTC if omitted. Returns 400 for invalid IANA timezone names.

Responses

{protocol}://{hostname}.{domain}{port}/{basePath}/{apiVersion}/v0.9/visualization

Partially update a wiki page (including relative-position move)

Authorizations:
api_key
path Parameters
uuid
required
string <UuidPtr>

The resource UUID

Request Body schema: application/vnd.api+json
required
object (WikiPagePatchResource)

JSON:API partial-update resource for a wiki page. Any subset of attributes and relationships may be supplied; unsupplied fields are left untouched.

Position changes are expressed relatively via the before or after relationships — at most one of the two may be set on a single request. Both reference a sibling wiki page by UUID; the server interprets them as a move hint, not a persistent link (they do not round-trip on GET). When a parent change is supplied without either, the page is appended to the end of the new parent's children. precedence is not accepted on PATCH (see PUT for the legacy absolute-precedence contract).

Responses

{protocol}://{hostname}.{domain}{port}/{basePath}/{apiVersion}/v0.9/wiki-page/{uuid}
